verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The closest items are AI Close automating month-end reconciliation and a marketing line that busywork is 'described once, done automatically'. Neither describes a user-defined recurring schedule, cadence or trigger, so neither can be credited as recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
